events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the iconic frontman of Oasis and a successful solo artist, celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: The one and only Liam Gallagher is 54 today! What's your favourite Oasis anthem or solo track from the main man?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' released 51 years ago
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' was released in the UK 51 years ago, becoming a powerful anthem for peace and unity.

angles.name: Imagine the Impact
angles.copy: 51 years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A timeless message that still resonates today. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: Apple's first iPod turns 25
events.blurb: Apple released the first iPod 25 years ago, revolutionising how we listen to music and paving the way for modern portable tech.

angles.name: Pocket Full of Tunes
angles.copy: Remember the original iPod? 25 years ago, Apple put '1,000 songs in your pocket' and changed music forever. What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated globally as James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Grab your martini, shaken not stirred, and tell us your favourite 007 film or theme tune.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today marks what would have been the 86th birthday of The Beatles' co-founder, singer, and songwriter, John Lennon.

angles.name: Remembering a Legend
angles.copy: John Lennon would have been 86 today. A musical visionary and a voice for peace, his legacy continues to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary English actor, comedian, and screenwriter John Cleese, best known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his genius is undeniable. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released 58 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released 58 years ago.

angles.name: The White Album Legacy
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles unveiled 'The White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece that still sparks debate. What's your go-to track from it?

events.title: 35 years since Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the world lost Freddie Mercury, the legendary frontman of Queen, who passed away at the age of 45.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: 35 years ago today, we lost a true icon. Freddie Mercury's voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song that showcases his genius?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released 61 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' 61 years ago, marking a pivotal moment in their artistic evolution.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Revolution
angles.copy: 61 years since The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. An album that pushed boundaries and set new standards. What's your favourite track from this classic?

events.title: 46 years since John Lennon's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of John Lennon, the visionary musician and peace activist, who was fatally shot in New York City.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: 46 years ago today, the world fell silent for John Lennon. His music and message of peace live on. What's the song that reminds you most of him?
